tools.name: aviation-intelligence_flight-schedule-normalize
tools.description: Normalize caller-supplied flight schedule fields and compute delay/block times when actual times are present. Paid flight tracking is not used. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/aviation-intelligence/flight-schedule-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: aviation-intelligence_flight-delay-pattern-analyze
tools.description: Aggregate delay statistics by flight number/route from caller-supplied scheduled and actual times. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/aviation-intelligence/flight-delay-pattern-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: aviation-intelligence_airport-connection-risk-calculate

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "aviation-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aviation-intelligence_aircraft-maintenance-log-parse, aviation-intelligence_document-expiry-check · Private data: aviation-intelligence_aircraft-registration-lookup, aviation-intelligence_document-expiry-check, aviation-intelligence_operations-report · Public sink: aviation-intelligence_flight-schedule-normalize, aviation-intelligence_flight-delay-pattern-analyze, aviation-intelligence_airport-connection-risk-calculate, aviation-intelligence_flight-diversion-event-track, aviation-intelligence_aircraft-registration-lookup, aviation-intelligence_aircraft-maintenance-log-parse, aviation-intelligence_document-expiry-check, aviation-intelligence_flight-emissions-estimate, aviation-intelligence_airport-ground-time-analyze, aviation-intelligence_operations-report · Destructive: aviation-intelligence_flight-schedule-normalize, aviation-intelligence_flight-delay-pattern-analyze, aviation-intelligence_airport-connection-risk-calculate, aviation-intelligence_flight-diversion-event-track, aviation-intelligence_aircraft-registration-lookup, aviation-intelligence_aircraft-maintenance-log-parse, aviation-intelligence_document-expiry-check, aviation-intelligence_flight-emissions-estimate, aviation-intelligence_airport-ground-time-analyze, aviation-intelligence_operations-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
